summary: Sporting News compiles Inter Miami's known 2024 preseason friendlies, built around Lionel Messi's time off after the club's 2023 MLS playoff elimination. The planned China tour was cancelled and replaced by a Noche d'Or friendly against NYCFC. Confirmed fixtures include Saudi Arabia games vs Al Hilal and Al Nassr (Messi vs Ronaldo), El Salvador, Hong Kong, Vissel Kobe and Newell's Old Boys, while a River Plate match in Dallas is only rumored.
one_line: Overview of Inter Miami's confirmed and rumored 2024 preseason friendlies featuring Messi, including Al Nassr, Vissel Kobe and Newell's Old Boys, after the China tour was cancelled.
key_facts: Inter Miami's 2024 MLS season begins in February 2024 after the club was eliminated from 2023 playoff contention.
Inter Miami plays Al Nassr in Riyadh on Thursday, February 1 at 1 p.m. ET (9 p.m. local time), as part of the Riyadh Season Cup.
Inter Miami also meets Saudi club Al Hilal three days before the Al Nassr match.
Messi and Ronaldo have faced each other 35 times: Messi won 16, Ronaldo 10, with nine draws; PSG won their last friendly 5-4 in Riyadh.
Inter Miami's first confirmed preseason friendly is against the El Salvador national team in San Sebastian on January 19.
Inter Miami plays a Hong Kong First Division selection on February 4 at Hong Kong Stadium (about 40,000 seats), with tickets on sale December 15 via Klook.
After Hong Kong, Inter Miami faces J1 League champions Vissel Kobe at the Japan National Stadium in Tokyo, with Andres Iniesta as a special guest.
Inter Miami hosts Newell's Old Boys at DRV PNK Stadium; Messi spent six years in Newell's youth academy and reportedly scored 234 goals.
Coach Martino played more than 400 senior games for Newell's before becoming head coach in 2012; both he and Messi are from Rosario.
A friendly against River Plate on January 20 at AT&T Stadium in Dallas was reported by German Balcarce but conflicts with the El Salvador match the day before.
The planned China tour (Qingdao Hainiu on November 5, Chengdu Rongcheng three days later) was reported cancelled on October 30 for 'commercial and bureaucratic' reasons.
Inter Miami played NYCFC on November 10 at DRV PNK Stadium in the 'Noche d'Or' friendly honoring Messi's latest Ballon d'Or.
